name: PreviewTargetedBackfill
read_consistency: one LLD-01 read snapshot over exact Source Scope/folder config, historical coverage, forward checkpoint and owner-provided trackable identities/revisions; no source message content is opened by preview
ordering: target identities by target_type registry order then immutable target_id; coverage rows by folder role/display/source_folder_id
pagination: none; request target count and configured folders are bounded by LLD-09 bounds
required_indexes: idx_comm_folder_scope_enabled plus owner identity provider indexes
rules: preview fingerprint binds source scope revision, folder selection, exact target identities/revisions/aliases, requested bounds and current coverage
preview never rewinds forward high-water or opens a Deep Scan implicitly
estimated totals remain null when not independently knowable
